speak.title: Role-play: a hip-opening class
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your yoga teacher says your hips hold stress. You want to book a hip-opening class. Explain why you believe it, and try to persuade your friend to come with you.

b.text: You've read that there's no good evidence for this idea. Ask your friend two questions about it, and suggest another way to feel better. You can agree, disagree or find a compromise.

phrases: I've heard that your hips hold stress.
That's what my yoga teacher told me.
I'm not sure there's any proof.
Why don't we try a gentle walk first?
If it doesn't get better, we'll see a doctor.
Let's try it and see how we feel.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: what did you decide, and why?
